kits_title: Choose a kit for your subject
kits_desc: Five ready configurations. Each with a set of sensors and TOP topics it covers.

kits.title: Physics
kits.desc: Kit for mechanics, thermal phenomena, electricity, waves and sound — grades 7 to 11.
kits.note: Kits come in 'teacher' and 'student' versions: one for the class, one for a group of 5–6 students.

topics.text: Waves and sound — sound and light sensors

kits.title: Chemistry
kits.desc: Acidity of solutions, reaction rates, gas evolution and conductivity of electrolytes.
kits.note: Kits come in 'teacher' and 'student' versions: one for the class, one for a group of 5–6 students.

topics.text: Gas evolution — CO₂, gas pressure, drop counter

kits.title: Biology
kits.desc: Respiration and photosynthesis, human physiology, environmental ecology and aquatic ecosystems.
kits.note: Kits come in 'teacher' and 'student' versions: one for the class, one for a group of 5–6 students.

topics.text: Human physiology — heart rate, CO₂, temperature, pH
Environmental ecology — temperature, CO₂, UV, soil moisture

kits.warn: Important: ECG and heart rate are educational demonstration sensors, NOT medical devices. Intended for demonstrating heart principles and educational experiments, not for diagnosis or clinical use.

kits.title: Geography
kits.desc: Weather and microclimate, atmosphere, water and soils, Earth's magnetic field and solar radiation.
kits.note: Kits come in 'teacher' and 'student' versions: one for the class, one for a group of 5–6 students.

topics.text: Weather and microclimate — temperature, humidity, pressure, UV
Water and soils — soil moisture, salinity, temperature

kits.title: Universal
kits.desc: A ready wide range of sensors that covers the maximum number of lessons and educational scenarios across all subjects.
kits.note: Kits come in 'teacher' and 'student' versions: one for the class, one for a group of 5–6 students.
steps: Take the universal kit as is
Ask for our help with selection for special requests
examples: «Focus on ecology needed» → add more air and water quality sensors
«Only physics grades 7–9» → minimize chemistry and biology, focus on mechanics
«We want STEM projects» → expand the set for interdisciplinary experiments
